Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the paternal grandfather by going one generation too far. After correctly noting that John II (Albert IV’s father) is the son of Albert II, the Planner concluded the grandfather was Albert I (John II’s grandfather/great-grandfather to Albert IV) instead of Albert II, resulting in an off-by-one generation error.
